vix_options.interpretation: VIX tail hedge call: typically small drag (theta cost) but spikes pay out big. Short VIX put: high win rate as VIX floor ~9-10 protects. Tactical long on spikes: attempts to catch second-leg vol moves.

key_findings.interpretation: Best strategy is VIX Options (best sub-strat) (avg Sharpe +0.846). Wheel returns -0.130 annualized vs buy-and-hold. Iron condor win rate 62.8% — high but watch max-loss events. VRP harvesting win rate 60.9% reflects IV>RV premium. Gamma scalping: RV > IV in 47.0% of months — paying the VRP makes this a slight drag on average.
